title: Peer-to-peer garage tool rental marketplace

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity sign-in and a basic user profile flow. Store a minimal profile (display name and optional contact note) tied to the authenticated principal, and expose create/read/update endpoints for the signed-in user.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in and sign out using Internet Identity
After sign-in, user can set and later edit a profile display name and optional contact note
Profile data is stored server-side and is retrievable on subsequent sessions for the same principal

requirements.text: Create backend data models and access control in the single Motoko actor for: UserProfile, ToolListing, and RentalRequest/Booking (including rental status transitions Requested, Approved, Declined, Cancelled, Completed). Ensure only owners can modify their listings and only involved parties can view/manage their requests/bookings.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthorized principals cannot create or update data on behalf of other users
Tool listing ownership is enforced for edit/delete operations
Only the tool owner can approve/decline requests for that tool
Rental status transitions are validated (no invalid jumps)

requirements.text: Implement stable persistence across upgrades for all core records (profiles, listings, rental requests/bookings) in the backend, preserving existing data during canister upgrades under the single-actor architecture.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: After simulated upgrade (where supported by the template), previously created profiles, listings, and requests/bookings remain available
Data structures used for stable storage cover all required fields for the app features

requirements.text: Build the tool listing feature: allow an authenticated owner to add, edit, and remove garage tool listings with fields: title, category, description, condition, daily price, optional security deposit, location (city/area text), availability flag, and photos. Photos must be managed on the frontend; store only image references/URLs/asset paths in the backend.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: Owner can create a new listing and see it in their 'My Tools' dashboard
Owner can edit and delete only their own listings
Listing detail view displays all listing fields including photo references
Backend stores photo references, not raw image bytes

requirements.text: Implement marketplace browsing for tool listings with search and filters: keyword search over title/description, category filter, price range filter, and an 'available only' toggle. Provide sorting options (newest, price low-to-high, price high-to-low) and a responsive listings grid.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: User can browse a listings grid and open a listing detail page
Search and filters update results correctly
Sorting changes the displayed order according to the selected option
The listings grid is usable on mobile and desktop widths

requirements.text: Add a rental request and booking workflow: renters can request a date range for a tool; owners can approve or decline; approved requests become bookings and block availability for that tool for the approved date range. Support at least the statuses: Requested, Approved, Declined, Cancelled, Completed.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated renter can submit a rental request with a start and end date for a listing
Owner can approve or decline incoming requests for their listing
Approving a request marks it Approved and prevents overlapping approved bookings for that tool/date range
Renter and owner can view the current status and key details of the request/booking

requirements.text: Create user dashboards: 'My Tools' (owner listings and their statuses), 'Requests' (incoming requests for owners), and 'My Rentals' (requests/bookings for renters). Each item must link to the corresponding tool and rental detail views.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: Signed-in owners can see their listings in 'My Tools'
Signed-in owners can see incoming rental requests in 'Requests'
Signed-in renters can see their submitted requests/bookings in 'My Rentals'
Each dashboard item links to the correct listing and request/booking details

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme suitable for a garage/tool marketplace across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling), avoiding a blue/purple primary palette. Use the existing UI component library by composing components rather than editing immutable UI sources. Add generated static brand imagery (logo and hero/landing illustration) under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

quotes: A peer‑to‑peer app where people can list and rent unused garage tools.

acceptanceCriteria: App uses a consistent theme (not blue/purple as the primary palette) across main views (landing, browse, listing detail, dashboards, create/edit listing)
No edits are made to immutable UI component source paths; components are composed instead
Logo and hero illustration are present in frontend/public/assets/generated and rendered in the UI

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Generate backend/migration.mo only if needed to preserve existing stable state on upgrade.

Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui); compose them instead.
Photos for tool listings must be frontend-managed; backend stores only image references/URLs/asset paths.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing payments, escrow, or Stripe integration.
Third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity.
Real-time features (WebSockets, live chat, push notifications).
External databases or backend services outside the single Motoko canister.

required: Garage tool marketplace logo, clean vector-style mark with a wrench/gear motif (toolshare-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Hero/landing illustration showing a friendly garage scene with tools being shared or rented, flat illustration style (toolshare-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
